prompt: Which uses a switch expression to convert a month number (1–12) to its name for January and February?
choices: String name = switch (month) { case 1 -> "January"; case 2 -> "February"; default -> "Other"; };
explanation: Switch expression with arrow syntax. Each case returns a value directly. default is required. Option A uses return inside a switch (only valid inside a method returning String). Option D: month is int, not an object, so .equals() won't compile.
